notes: Old models Knackwurst, Bologna, Jagdwurst, Mortadella Bologna, Braunschweiger, Pfälzer Leberwurst became archetypes. Kabanos left to the dry-sausage shelf. Teewurst is liver-free raw spreadable sausage, so it was not placed under Liver sausage (handed to 'Nduja & spreadable sausages in 06_02). Clonakilty and Dietz & Watson recorded from knowledge; Simonini (Mortadella Bologna maker in old source) left out of the register. Münchner Weißwurst protection status not confirmed, left out.
